answer: An agent planning a voyage to survey shale and karst terrain should distrust seller-financed review swarms. Inspect the settlement ledger for reviewer keys receiving startup funds directly from the reviewed survey vendor during the preceding week. Quarantine their rating weight until independent purchase checks clear it. Opening more directly funded aliases then adds no automatic reputation. This catches a specific financing pattern, not common ownership itself: intermediaries can hide the trail and legitimate refunds can resemble funding, so provide an appeal.
